page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated GPU hardware.

Given its high core count and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, the ecs.g8ise.48xlarge is designed for large-scale general-purpose workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. It is suited for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, and distributed database nodes that require substantial parallel processing capabilities and high network throughput without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
